topic: Reconcile conflicting supplier delivery dates and inventory records across fragmented ERP export (Postgres), Logistics Ticket API, and Risk Feed without fabricating missing data.

zetaris.query: SELECT supplier_id, order_id, promised_date, status, source_system, freshness FROM supplier_cross_silo_sync

FactChecker.position: Direct conflict detected for supplier SUP-8021 (Acme Global): ERP records promise delivery on 2026-11-01 as 'Shipped', but Logistics Ticket API (2h freshness) and Vendor Risk feed (6h freshness) both report delivery delayed to 2026-11-14 due to a port strike chokepoint. The ERP export (15m freshness) has not yet ingested the logistics carrier exception event.
evidence: Logistics Ticket API reports SUP-8021 delayed to 2026-11-14 with High risk
Vendor Risk Parquet corroborates critical port chokepoint
caveats: ERP export is 15m fresh but lacks carrier API webhook updates; logistics ticket has 2h latency.

FactChecker.position: Reconciled conclusion: SUP-8021 delivery date must be treated as 2026-11-14 (delayed by 13 days). We cite ERP for initial PO creation, Logistics API for operational delay status, and Vendor Risk for root cause verification. SUP-4419 is reconciled as fully delivered with unanimous 2-source agreement.
evidence: No data fabricated for missing intermediate checkpoint timestamps
caveats: Customs clearance timestamps require manual broker confirmation.

CloudArchitect.position: Implement a federated reconciliation schema: attach source system provenance, record observation timestamps, and compute freshness confidence weights (Logistics API weight: 0.65 for shipment status vs ERP weight: 0.35 for dynamic transit). Avoid naïve overwrite.
evidence: 3 distinct data silos: Postgres ERP export, REST Ticket API, and Object Storage Parquet
caveats: API throttling on the ticket system could delay real-time alerts.

CloudArchitect.position: Approve the multi-source reconciliation architecture. Establish automated bidirectional synchronization: flag the ERP record as pending revision, publish a webhook to warehouse ops, and log cryptographic audit hashes of all three source payloads.
evidence: Zetaris federated query executes across relational and object storage without ETL
Reconciled output schema includes explicit source attribution columns
caveats: Production rollout requires automated retry queues for logistics webhooks.

Synthesizer.position: Synthesizing cross-silo records: SUP-8021 exhibits an active data divergence. Recommending a single sourced answer: mark delivery as delayed to 2026-11-14 with high operational risk, clearly citing the Logistics and Risk sources while noting the ERP latency gap.

Final Sourced Consensus: Successfully reconciled fragmented intelligence across ERP, Ticket API, and Risk feeds. Established canonical status for SUP-8021 (Delayed to 2026-11-14, High Risk) and SUP-4419 (Delivered, Zero Risk). Every fact is explicitly attributed to its origin silo with zero hallucination of missing intermediate dates.
evidence: Provenance table attached to audit envelope
Conflict resolution rule favors verified external logistics signal over un-refreshed ERP snapshot
Signed audit event emitted to tamper-proof ledger
caveats: Physical inspection recommended upon vessel docking.
